photos.c: BACKPIECE PHOTOS: TOP LEFT: Barefooted Hart in the throes of a 9 miles battle with Dai Davies (TVH) who pipped him by one place. TOP RIGHT: Bicourt leads Ward (Man.DLC), Billings (Sutt.in A) and team-mate O'Hara. John finished one place ahead of Billings and 23 up on Ward. BOTTOM: A desperate North fights to hold off Bob Holt, Peter Welsh (Empire S'chase gold-medallist) and Mike Turner.
BOTTOM: After doing his fair share of the pace-making, John Thresher loses ground in the final stages to winner R. Holt (Hercules) who got home by a 1.6 sec margin.
John fights it out with Alan Rushmer during the 1967 AAA championships at White City. M. Tagg and R. Holt (21) follow up.
GERRY NORTH leads the ultimate winner Bob Holt (H/W) in the "Brockman" 10,000 m.
Bob Smith and John Bicourt lead the chase after Bob Holt (H/W) in the Surrey County 5,000m Championships at Motspur Park. Holt (14:14.6) won from Bob (14:23.6) with John taking the bronze in 14:39.8.

January 3rd 1970 at Milford Heath and no. 80, Bob Holt (Hercules Wimbledon), leads the Surrey Senior Cross Country Championships from no. 13, Gerry North (Belgrave). Bob eventually won with Gerry runner up and Dave Holt, pictured behind Bob, 3rd. Also to be seen are Chris Wade of Ranelagh (brother of tennis star Virginia), no. 11 Adrian Major (Belgrave) who placed 5th, no. 77, Mick Fuller (Hercules Wimbledon) and we can just spot Bob Gevers (SLH). Hercules Wimbledon won the team race from Mitcham with the Bels. 3rd.
